newsitem.title: USA: Ancor Communications named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Ancor Communications named in lawsuit.

text.p: A civil complaint alleging securities law violations has been filed against Ancor Communications Inc and certain of its officers and directors, plaintiffs' lawyers said Tuesday.

The complaint, which is seeking class-action status, was filed in federal court in Minnesota on behalf of buyers of Ancor common stock during the period May 15, 1996, to March 15, 1997, the lawyers said.
Mary Miller, a spokeswoman for Minnetonka, Minn.-based Ancor,said, "We have not been served anything or seen the charges and so we cannot comment."

According to the plaintiffs' lawyers, the complaint alleges that Ancor and the other defendants made a series of false and misleading statements regarding, among other things a $30 million contract with another firm and financial results for the second, third and fourth quarters of 1996.
As a result, buyers of Anchor common stock were hurt, the lawyers said. Plaintiffs are seeking to recover damages, they added.
The firms representing the plaintiffs are Rabin & Peckel LLP, Hellmuth & Johnson, and the law office of Leo W. Desmond.
